criteria.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs builds a line whose last attempt is Rejected with 8 of 9 criteria met and spend over T3_PAUSE_RATIO times the forecast, and asserts t3_cost returns a level below Pause (checked by running cargo test); the same test with 3 of 9 met asserts Pause, so it fails without the change.
criteria.evidence: I ran it: 9 near_complete tests passed. `a_near_complete_rejection_does_not_pause_t3` (scope_guard.rs:2827) asserts `t3_cost(&[near(8,9,3.0)], 2.0) == Flag` and `near(3,9,3.0) == Pause`. Spend 3.0 is 1.5 times the forecast of 2.0. It also covers 7 of 9, 4 of 5, 9 of 9, unbounded, no progress, a Failed last attempt and the order of attempts. The whole-path rig tests check that the first near-complete rejection is flagged and its retry runs, and that the second one pauses. Athena's fails-without-1 run shows the tests do not compile on the base (no `progress` field).

criteria.criterion: A unit test shows an attempt record built by attempt_of from a rejected job's verification carries the met and total criterion counts (checked by running cargo test), and a Failed or Environment attempt carries none.
criteria.evidence: I ran it: `attempt_of_records_how_far_a_near_complete_rejection_got` passed. It asserts `progress == Some(Progress{met:1,total:2,bounded:true})` for the rig's rejected job, and None when there is no verification. It also asserts (Failed, None) for a producer failure, (Environment, None) for a real `LowDisk` text, and (Accepted, None) for a landed job (scope_guard.rs:2206-2255). `near_complete_gap_is_bounded_only_by_findings_of_the_gap` also passed in the near_complete run.

criteria.criterion: The doc comments of AttemptRecord and t3_cost in crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs name the root cause (the guard treated every attempt's spend as one number and did not record how far a rejected attempt got), and say that environment stops stay excluded through crate::disk::is_environment_reason, with no second list of environment reasons.
criteria.evidence: The `AttemptRecord` doc (lines 129-136) says: 'the scope guard treated every attempt's spend as one number and did not record how far a rejected attempt got ... An environment stop stays excluded through [`crate::disk::is_environment_reason`] (called by [`verdict_of`]), the one classifier; there is no second list'. The `t3_cost` doc (lines 397-405) states the same root cause and the same exclusion. `verdict_of` is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Existing scope_guard tests for environment stops (environment_stop_is_not_counted_but_a_rejection_is, every_kind_of_environment_stop_is_an_environment_attempt) still pass under cargo test.
criteria.evidence: I ran it: 23 passed, 0 failed. Both named tests passed, as did `only_a_job_closed_failed_is_an_environment_attempt` and `a_line_of_expired_login_stops_raises_no_signal`.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this change, and no refusal rule is added to crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs.

The diff stat lists only CHANGELOG.md, drain.rs, disk.rs, scope_guard.rs and status.rs; reading.rs is not changed. Athena's replay found 0 of 50 accepted readings newly refused.

findings.summary: The one-time T3 allowance resets after a Failed attempt, so a line that alternates near-complete rejections and failures is never paused by T3.
findings.evidence: `targeted_retry` looks only at the counted attempt just before the last one. The test asserts `[near(8,9,3.0), Failed, near(8,9,0.1)] == Flag` (line 2873). T4, T5 (120 min) and the drain's two-unlanded hold still stop such a line, so this is not a runaway. Tracking whether the allowance was already used over the whole line would be simpler and tighter.

findings.summary: The 0.8 near-complete share was not compared against past lines, although a snapshot of the real records was available to this job.
findings.evidence: The CHANGELOG says the effect on past lines 'was not measured, because the records were not in the working copy'. The constant is labelled as an estimate, as the reading asked. A follow-up measuring it against the jobs/verification records would ground it.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG entry is one very long paragraph that repeats implementation detail.
findings.evidence: The bullet is about 600 words and spells out each condition of `gaps_only`. That detail already lives in the code docs.

findings.summary: The 'pause withheld' note is left out of the T3 flag text when the line's last attempt is an environment stop.
findings.evidence: `facts` reads `attempts.last().and_then(|a| a.progress)`. For `[near(8,9,3.0), env]`, T3 is Flag, but the last attempt has no progress, so the flag text does not say the pause was withheld. Using the last counted attempt would fix it.

findings.summary: In the accepted reading, the root-cause sentence is cut off mid-word ('...Environment stops are already excluded (disk.rs StopCause)...'), and the request's own cause text is truncated.
findings.evidence: This does not affect the change. The reading's analysis that environment stops were already handled is confirmed: on the base, `verdict_of` already calls `crate::disk::is_environment_reason`.

summary: The change does what the request asks. The scope guard's `AttemptRecord` now carries `Progress` (criteria met, total, and whether the unmet criteria are the only thing that rejected the attempt). `attempt_of` sets it only for a Rejected attempt that has a verification. `t3_cost` flags instead of pausing when the last counted attempt is near-complete (at least 80% of criteria met, bounded), and it allows this once while over the limit. Environment stops are still excluded through the existing `crate::disk::is_environment_reason`, and the change adds no second list of environment reasons. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core near_complete` (9 tests passed), the attempt_of progress test (passed) and the whole `scope_guard::tests::` module (23 passed, including both environment-stop tests). Athena's fails-without run shows the new tests do not compile without the fix. The changed files are exactly the expected deliverables, `reading.rs` is untouched, and CHANGELOG.md has a new entry that names the root cause. fmt, clippy and test passed in the recorded CI run. I found no blocker or major problems. There are three minor findings and two nits: the one-time allowance resets after a Failed attempt; the 0.8 share was never compared against the past records, even though a snapshot of them was available; the CHANGELOG entry is very long; the "withheld" note is missing from the flag when the line's last attempt was an environment stop; and one sentence of the reading is cut off.
